001: Hi, how are you? Can you help me pick out a blouse?
Of course! What color do you prefer?
I like blue, but I want something different.
How about this green one? It looks really good on your skin tone.
It is pretty. How much does it cost?
It's sixty reais, but today there's a ten percent discount.
002: Excuse me, where are the shoes?
They're on the second floor, near the men's clothing.
Thank you. And do you have size thirty-eight?
Yes, we do, but only in black and brown.
Black works. Can I try them on?
Sure, I'll go get them for you.
003: This skirt is very pretty, but I think it's expensive.
It's from a famous brand, that's why the price is higher.
I see. Is there any sale today?
Yes, there is. If you buy two items, you get a twenty percent discount.
Then I'll take this skirt and those pants too.
Great choice! I'll set them aside for you.
004: Do you like this bag or that smaller one?
I prefer the smaller one, it's more practical for everyday use.
That's true, but the bigger one fits more things.
It depends on what you need to carry.
I need to carry my laptop and some books.
Then the bigger one is better for you.
005: Hi, I'm looking for a gift for my mom.
How nice! What does she like?
We have some new perfumes that arrived this week.
This one with a floral scent is the best seller.
006: This shirt is tight on me. Do you have a bigger size?
If you don't have it, can I order it from another store?
Unfortunately, we don't do that, but we can order it for you.
How long does it take to arrive?
007: How much does this party dress cost?
It costs two hundred and fifty reais.
That's a bit expensive for me. Is there a discount?
I can give you fifteen percent off if you pay in cash.
That works, I'll take it then.
Perfect! Should I wrap it as a gift?
008: Did you see that leather jacket in the display window?
Yes, I did, I thought it was very stylish.
I want to try it on, but I don't know if my size is available.
Excuse me, what's the price of the black jacket?
It's three hundred reais, but we only have size forty-two.
009: Do these jeans fit me? I think I'm between two sizes.
Try these on, I think they'll fit perfectly.
They fit well, but they're a bit long.
We can hem them for you at no extra cost.
Really? That's great! When will they be ready?
They'll be ready in two days.
010: Hi, I want to return this t-shirt I bought yesterday.
Is there a problem with it?
It got stained after the first wash.
Perfect, I'll do the exchange or refund your money.
